headings.rules: Used exclusively for executive metrics, section titles, and high-level KPIs. No 'Inter' or generic sans for headings.

body.rules: Optimized for dense operational tables and logs. Left-aligned.

mono.rules: Use for hashes, UUIDs, model versions, and code.

colors.rules: Never use pure black. Use tinted deep blue-grays. Accent colors must strictly map to risk severities or AI insight.

badges.confidence: Render as a miniature horizontal bar chart or percentage alongside the metric. Colors shift from green (high) to amber (low).
badges.freshness: Render with a clock icon. 'Live' = green pulse; '>24h' = muted gray.
badges.source: Small database or document icon with tooltips showing system of origin.

data_distinction.fact: Solid 1px border around the metric or cell, high-contrast text.
data_distinction.ai_recommendation: Subtle 1px glowing cyan border (hsl(190, 90%, 50%)) or subtle left-accent line to clearly demarcate AI-generated content.

surfaces.cards: Flat background (hsl(215, 38%, 10%)), 1px subtle border (hsl(215, 30%, 18%)), NO shadow. Inner padding p-6.
surfaces.glass: Use for sticky headers only: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 border-b border-border/40.

executive_mode.rules: Asymmetrical focus. The Health Index takes col-span-full lg:col-span-8 row-span-2. Sub-metrics take col-span-4.

operational_mode.rules: Strict, dense rows. Tables take col-span-full. Every pixel utilized.

layouts.navigation: Top or left persistent navigation with the Executive/Operational Mode Toggle centrally placed or highly prominent. Includes breadcrumbs for deep evidence lineage.
layouts.spacing: Use p-6 to p-8 inside cards. The main wrapper must have generous padding to let the bento grid breathe.
layouts.alignment: KPI numbers left-aligned. Tables left-aligned. Only empty states can be center-aligned.

motion.ai_pulse: animate-pulse for AI active generating states, using subtle cyan.

accessibility.contrast: Text must pass WCAG AA against dark backgrounds. Use hsl(210, 40%, 90%) for body, hsl(210, 40%, 98%) for headers.
accessibility.testing: All actionable items must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='mode-toggle-button', data-testid='kpi-health-index').

media.charts: Use Recharts (customized via Shadcn) for trend lines and gauges. Use strict semantic colors for series.

3d_libraries.evidence_lineage: Use React Flow for mapping Evidence Lineage (source -> observation -> recommendation -> decision -> action). It provides the exact node-based structure needed for root-cause trees.

component_name.DualModeToggle: A high-end segmented control that switches the entire dashboard context.
component_name.EnterpriseHealthGauge: A customized semi-circle gauge chart showing the component score breakdown.
component_name.RiskRegisterTable: A dense data table with inherent vs residual heat scoring (semantic colors mapped to cells).
component_name.MetricCard: Displays KPI, trend, and the mandatory source/freshness/confidence badges.
component_name.AIAdvisorChat: A side-panel or floating chat interface showing AI recommendations with explicit citation badges.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark blue network data connection, to be used sparingly with heavy opacity (opacity-10) behind the Executive login or empty state.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: You MUST configure Tailwind with the provided HSL color variables.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Initialize Shadcn UI and overwrite standard card/table/badge components to remove generic Vercel looks. Make them flat with sharp 1px borders.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Install `lucide-react` or `@phosphor-icons/react` for detailed enterprise dashboard iconography.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Implement the 'Dual-Mode toggle' at the root layout state, which conditionally renders either the ExecutiveBoard or OperationalBoard components.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for any cards, popovers, or tables.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Data generation: Mock rich enterprise data to populate the Risk Register, Health Index, and AI Model Inventory. The data should reflect a cyber-security / AI governance context.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Integrate 'Fact vs Estimate vs AI-Recommendation' styling rules across all rendered metrics.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`.
